# Live props

<!-- Generated by php artisan standards:install from tey/standards; do not edit. -->

Inertia live props refresh an open page when a notice broadcasts: tey/kit's LiveProps::on makes the view-model props live (capability-gated with `when`), echoLiveTransport carries them, useLiveFallbackPoll keeps a slow poll, and a component's own reader stands down with useIsLive. The notice is ShouldBroadcastNow, on a private workspace-scoped channel authorised in routes/channels.php.

No generator yet; follow the summary and stamp the file `standards-pattern: background.live`.

Kit: none.
Checks: live.broadcast-now. Run `php artisan standards:check --changed` before committing.
